definitions.start: Opening year is year 1; late begins at calendar_year - start_year >= 9.
definitions.exposure: Years with a pending/ready state or a scheduled event/draw; death in the vital phase before scheduling is excluded.
definitions.choices: Successful resolveOption logs, deduplicated by event instance. Card selection and stage resolution are not choices.
definitions.progress: Net attribute/identity/region/injury/achievement/material-flag/chain-status changes; chain node visits are reported separately. Two budget bookkeeping flags and node indices are excluded.
definitions.budget: Five successful choices maximum; category exhaustion additionally requires direction and historical slots used, no pending choice and no future choice on an active chain.
definitions.targeted: Target-card runs actively replace an offer when needed and are conditional scenarios, not natural selection rates.
definitions.percentiles: Nearest rank among year-10 survivors; null denotes empty denominator.
